Last ran Feb 25, 2026

Load libraries
```{r setup}
library(BPCells)
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
all_ge = open_matrix_dir("../shared objs and code/post_qc_decontx_counts/")
neuronal_assignments = readRDS("../shared objs and code/neuronal_number_ids_cluster_assignments.rds")
non_neuronal_assignments = readRDS("../shared objs and code/non_neuronal_assignments.rds")
assignments = c(neuronal_assignments, non_neuronal_assignments)
all_ge = all_ge[,names(assignments)]



```




```{r}
cell_metadata = data.frame(cell_id = names(assignments), cluster = assignments)
#get animal id from name of cell ()
cell_metadata$animal_id = gsub(".*_(\\d+)-.*", "\\1", cell_metadata$cell_id)

df_internal_and_official_name = read_csv("../shared objs and code/internal_to_official_name_conversions_neuronal.csv")
cell_metadata =cell_metadata %>% mutate(cluster = case_when(
  cluster %in% df_internal_and_official_name$numeric_id ~ df_internal_and_official_name$official_name[match(cluster,df_internal_and_official_name$numeric_id)],#neuronal
  .default = cluster #non-neuronal
)) 
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% mutate(cell_class = case_when(
  cluster %in% df_internal_and_official_name$official_name ~ "neuronal",
  grepl("vascular-endothelial", cluster) ~ "endothelial",
  grepl("vascular-pericytes", cluster) ~ "pericytes",
  grepl("vascular-smc", cluster) ~ "smooth muscle",
  .default = sub("[-_].*", "", cluster)
))

#get median UMIs and genes detected total
nUMIs_ge = colSums(all_ge)
median_umis_ge = median(nUMIs_ge) #8997
nGenesDetected_ge = colSums(all_ge > 0)
median_umis_all = median(nGenesDetected_ge)

cell_metadata$nUMIs = nUMIs_ge[cell_metadata$cell_id]
cell_metadata$nGenesDetected = nGenesDetected_ge[cell_metadata$cell_id]
```


```{r}
cell_metadata$cell_class = str_to_title(cell_metadata$cell_class)

cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% mutate(
  cell_class = case_when(
     cell_class == "Bam" ~ "BAM",
     cell_class == "Smooth Muscle" ~ "SMC",
     cell_class == "Smc" ~ "SMC",
     cell_class == "Vlmc" ~ "VLMC",
     cell_class == "Opc" ~ "OPC",
     cell_class == "Tcells" ~ "T-Cells",
    .default = cell_class
  )
)
#plot boxplot of nUMIs and nGenesDetected by Cell class
p_umis = ggplot(cell_metadata, aes(x=cell_class, y=log10(nUMIs))) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = F) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Cell Class") +
  ylab("Log10 number of UMIs") +
  ggtitle("UMIs per Cell Class") + theme_classic(base_family = "Helvetica",base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 30),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
  )



p_genes_detected = ggplot(cell_metadata, aes(x=cell_class, y=nGenesDetected)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = F) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Cell Class") +
  ylab("Number of Genes Detected") +
  ggtitle("Genes Detected per Cell Class") +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Helvetica",base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 30),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
  )


library(patchwork)
qc_plot_umis_gd = p_umis / p_genes_detected

ggsave("supp fig nUMIs and genes detected per class.pdf", qc_plot_umis_gd,width = 20,height = 20)
```
